description_en: Queries Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instances associated with specific access points in a region
description_zh: 查询指定地域内指定接入点下智能接入网关实例信息
name: ListSmartAGByAccessPoint

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed.

A region contains one or more access points. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183876.html operation to query access points in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所在的地域ID。

一个地域内包含一个或多个接入点。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183876.html查看地域下的接入点信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。默认值为10。最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access point
parameters.name: access_point_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The status of the SAG instance. Valid values:

Active: The SAG device is connected to Alibaba Cloud.

offline: The SAG device is disconnected from Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例状态。取值：

Active：可用。
Offline：离线
parameters.name: smart_ag_status

SmartAccessGateways.description_en: The information about the SAG instance
SmartAccessGateways.description_zh: 智能接入网关实例信息

AssociatedCcnId.description_en: The ID of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance with which the SAG instance is associated
AssociatedCcnId.description_zh: 智能接入网关实例绑定的云连接网实例ID

HardwareVersion.description_en:
The model of the SAG device with which the SAG instance is associated. Valid values:

sag-1000.

sag-100WM
HardwareVersion.description_zh:
智能接入网关实例绑定的设备类型。

sag-1000。
sag-100WM

RoutingStrategy.description_en:
The method that the SAG instance uses to synchronize Alibaba Cloud-facing routes. Valid values:

static: static routing.

dynamic: dynamic routing
RoutingStrategy.description_zh:
当前智能接入网关实例线下路由同步方式。取值：

static：静态路由。
dynamic：动态路由

SmartAGDescription.description_en: The description of the SAG instance
SmartAGDescription.description_zh: 智能接入网关实例描述

SmartAGId.description_en: The ID of the SAG instance

SmartAGName.description_en: The name of the SAG instance
SmartAGName.description_zh: 智能接入网关实例名称

SmartAGStatus.description_en:
The status of the SAG instance. Valid values:

Active: The SAG device is connected to Alibaba Cloud.

offline: The SAG device is disconnected from Alibaba Cloud
SmartAGStatus.description_zh:
智能接入网关实例状态：

TotalCount.description_en: The number of SAG instances within the access point
TotalCount.description_zh: 当前接入点下智能接入网关实例总个数
